name: Life V-aiR - Serious Game
summary:
# ⚠️ READ BEFORE YOU PLAY ⚠️
This game is a training tool used by the Life V-aiR project partners to raise decision makers awareness about air quality issues. 
It is supposed to be played in cooperation with a player outside the headset using a "Technical Manual".
If you're interested in playing, please contact the developer of the game ! 
# How to play
If you already know the concept of the game, please download the Technical Manual on this page : 
https://tinyurl.com/LifeVaiRTechnicalManuals
